verdict.rationale: Statsig documents Scheduled Rollouts, which let a Feature Gate ramp up gradually on a set schedule. That is a narrow form of time-based workflow automation. The CLI can also be wired into CI/CD pipelines, but the scheduling there would come from an external tool rather than from Statsig. missing for 10: general-purpose recurring job or workflow scheduling, cron-style recurrence, scheduled reports or other actions beyond rollouts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
